policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

method: After an actual constraint-driven objective GP rebuild, preserve the frozen candidate and past evidence but begin its comparison with the new incumbent using four later labels. Withdraw same-label support before installation; leave ordinary updates and preserved heads unchanged. Later validation remains passive and the original empirical adoption threshold remains unchanged.
selection: All111 existing paths with a frozen objective candidate at an actual objective GP rebuild, including same-stage first-four adoption, plus six bounded unchanged controls. Selection uses recorded branch entry, not outcome direction. Initial twelve-case development includes old cross-rebuild adoptions, a same-stage adoption, retained candidates, and all six controls.
reuse_rule: Reuse319 v0.48 paths whose recorded candidate lifetime contains no non-preserved objective head rebuild, and which are not the six actual controls. The method is otherwise unchanged. Completed-at-the-same-stage candidates are included conservatively. Saved v0.48 references include the previously validated passive/full no-entry reuse; they are not new executions.
accounting: 117 historical v0.49 runs plus54 fresh paired runs cost5472 online calls. Historical initial/evaluator data and baseline outcomes are reused. Fresh shared acquisition cost384 initial and1920 evaluation calls:7776 new physical calls. Every arm has32 initial and32 online calls. No new vanilla or CodeAgent runs.
limitations: Historical436 are development evidence. The27 newly declared seed/profile cases are fresh for this method. Historical timing is not a simultaneous runtime comparison. Missing historical noisy objective evaluator observations remain missing; no truth substitution.
